context_pill: Income Tax • Capital Gains on HUF Partition Asset
example_summary: Computation of Long-Term Capital Gains on sale of land acquired by Mr. A upon partition of X & sons, HUF.
source_provision:
| Statutory Provision | Trigger Event / Condition | Operative Rule / Benchmark | Legal Tax Consequence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Section 47(i)** | Total or partial partition of an HUF | Distribution of capital asset to member | **Not a Transfer** (No capital gains tax on partition) |
| **Section 49(1)** | Sale of asset acquired on HUF partition | Cost to the **Previous Owner** (HUF) | Deemed **Cost of Acquisition** for member |
| **Section 2(42A)** | Determination of nature of Capital Asset | Includes period held by previous owner | Tacked-on **Period of Holding** (STCA vs LTCA) |
| **Section 55(1)(b)** | Capital expenditure incurred after 01-04-2001 | Incurred by member or previous owner | Deductible **Cost of Improvement** |
| **Section 48** | Final computation of Capital Gain | FVC less Expenses less Cost less Improvement | **Taxable Capital Gain** |

> [!IMPORTANT] Core Principles for Assets Received on HUF Partition

- **No Transfer u/s 47(i):** Distribution of assets on total or partial partition of HUF does not attract capital gains tax.

- **Cost & Holding Period Rule:** For subsequent sales by the member, the cost of acquisition is the cost incurred by the HUF u/s 49(1), and the holding period of the HUF is added u/s 2(42A).

- **Cost of Improvement u/s 55(1)(b):** Includes capital expenses incurred by the HUF or member after 1st April 2001.

> [!WARNING] Valuation Benchmark on Partition
> The market valuation or allotment value assigned to the asset at the time of HUF partition is legally irrelevant for computing cost of acquisition. The statutory cost u/s 49(1) remains the actual cost paid by the HUF.

director.justification: The case requires step-by-step computation of capital gains under Section 48 using deemed cost of acquisition to previous owner u/s 49(1) and cost of improvement u/s 55(1)(b).
director.visual_metaphor: A transparent financial ledger overriding partition valuation with historical HUF cost.

title.text: Sale of Land Acquired on HUF Partition

beats.voice_sync_text: Mr. A, a coparcener of X & sons, HUF, sold a plot of land for ₹ 15,00,000 in June 2025. ഒരു HUF Partition വഴിയോ Gift വഴിയോ ലഭിക്കുന്ന Capital Asset വിൽക്കുമ്പോൾ Capital Gains എങ്ങനെ കണക്കാക്കണം എന്നതിന്റെ Statutory Provisions പഠിക്കാം.
beats.director_goal: Introduce the sale transaction of plot acquired via HUF partition

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 47(i) അനുസരിച്ച് ഒരു HUF Partition ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ members-ന് ലഭിക്കുന്ന Capital Asset ഒരു Transfer ആയി കണക്കാക്കില്ല. So HUF Partition is Not a Transfer.
beats.director_goal: Establish that distribution of asset on HUF partition is not a transfer

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 49(1) പ്രകാരം, property വിൽക്കുമ്പോൾ cost calculation-നായി Cost to Previous Owner എന്ത് വിലയ്ക്കാണ് വാങ്ങിയിരുന്നത്, ആ തുകയാണ് Cost of Acquisition ആയി എടുക്കേണ്ടത്. Section 49(1) overrides the partition allotment valuation of ₹ 1,50,000 with the original HUF cost of ₹ 1,20,000.

visual_data.rule: Section 49(1): Ignore partition value; adopt Cost to Previous Owner (HUF).

beats.director_goal: Substitute partition allotment valuation with statutory cost to previous owner

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 2(42A) Explanation 1(a)(i) പ്രകാരം, Previous Owner asset കൈവശം വെച്ചിരുന്ന കാലയളവ് കൂടെ ചേർത്ത് വേണം Total Period of Holding നിർണ്ണയിക്കാൻ. Holding started in P.Y. 2002-03, making it a Long-Term Capital Asset.

visual_data.window_label: Section 2(42A): Period of Holding includes HUF period -> Long-Term Capital Asset

beats.director_goal: Determine period of holding by tacking on HUF holding period

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 55(1)(b) അനുസരിച്ച് Assesseeയോ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ Previous Ownerഓ വരുത്തിയ Capital Expenditure-കൾ Cost of Improvement ആയി claim ചെയ്യാം. Fencing cost of ₹ 2,35,000 is deductible. Section 48 പ്രകാരം Full Value of Consideration-ൽ നിന്ന് Transfer Expenses കുറച്ച് Net Consideration കാണാം. net amount-ൽ നിന്ന് deductions കഴിച്ചാൽ taxable capital gain ₹ 11,25,000 കിട്ടും.
beats.director_goal: Compute taxable long-term capital gain using final ledger deduction steps

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 49(1) പ്രകാരം Previous Owner Cost ആണ് Cost of Acquisition ആകുന്നത്. HUF Partition-ൽ ലഭിക്കുന്ന സ്വത്ത് വിൽക്കുമ്പോൾ Taxable Capital Gain ഈ രീതിയിൽ കൃത്യമായി കണക്കാക്കാം.

rules.label: HUF Partition Not a Transfer
rules.detail: Section 47(i): Distribution to members on partition does not attract tax.

rules.label: Previous Owner Cost
rules.detail: Section 49(1): Cost to HUF (₹ 1,20,000) is adopted, ignoring partition valuation.

rules.label: Tacked-on Period of Holding
rules.detail: Section 2(42A): HUF holding period added, asset classified as Long-Term.

rules.label: Taxable Capital Gain
rules.detail: Section 48: Net consideration less cost & improvement yields ₹ 11,25,000.

beats.director_goal: Summarize core takeaway for HUF partition asset sales
